params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Renekton}} {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|ability}} hits generate {{as|{{tip|Fury}}}}, which continually expires after a period without fighting. He generates {{as|'''bonus''' Fury}} while {{as|'''below''' half health}}.
params.blurb2: While '''Renekton''' has at least {{as|50% Fury}}, his next basic ability consumes {{as|50% Fury}} to become empowered with an additional effect.
params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Renekton's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|fury|{{as|5 Fury}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}. After 12 seconds of being out of combat and not basic attacking, he loses {{as|1 Fury}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

Entering combat or using an attack will stop the {{as|Fury}} loss and refresh the timer. Additionally, while ''{{ai|Dominus|Renekton}}'' is active, the timer is continuously refreshed.
params.description2: While '''Renekton''' has at least {{as|50 Fury}}, his next {{tip|ability|basic ability}}, excluding ''{{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton|Slice}}'', consumes {{as|50 Fury}} to become empowered with an additional effect. Empowered abilities do not generate {{as|Fury}}.
params.description3: '''Renekton''' generates {{as|50% '''bonus''' Fury}} from all sources while {{as|below 50% of his '''maximum''' health}}.
params.notes:
* Basic attacks against any enemy that is not a structure will generate the Fury.
** '''Renekton''' can generate Fury by collecting {{ui|Honeyfruit}} and [[Health Relic]]s (interacts with ''Reign of Anger's'' bonus generation).
* {{Pending for test}} Fury generation with parrying effects ({{tip|blind}}, {{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}})

blurb.plain: Innate: Renekton basic attacks on-hit and ability hits generate Fury, which continually expires after a period without fighting. He generates bonus Fury while below half health.

blurb2.plain: While Renekton has at least 50% Fury, his next basic ability consumes 50% Fury to become empowered with an additional effect.

description.plain: Innate: Renekton's basic attacks generate 5 Fury on-hit. After 12 seconds of being out of combat and not basic attacking, he loses 1 Fury every 0.25 seconds. Entering combat or using an attack will stop the Fury loss and refresh the timer. Additionally, while Dominus is active, the timer is continuously refreshed.

description2.plain: While Renekton has at least 50 Fury, his next basic ability, excluding Slice, consumes 50 Fury to become empowered with an additional effect. Empowered abilities do not generate Fury.

description3.plain: Renekton generates 50% bonus Fury from all sources while below 50% of his maximum health.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Renekton}} cleaves around himself, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. He also generates {{as|Fury}} and {{tip|heal|heals}} for each enemy hit, increased against {{tip|champions}}.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} ''Cull the Meek'' has increased damage and healing.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renekton''' cleaves around himself, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|heal|healing}} himself for each enemy hit, up to a cap.
params.leveling2: {{st|Champion Healing|{{ap|12 to 44}} {{as|(+ 17% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Enhanced Champion Healing|{{ap|36 to 132}} {{as|(+ 51% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.description3: '''Renekton''' generates {{tip|fury|{{as|{{fd|2.5}} Fury}}}} for each non-champion hit and {{as|10 Fury}} for each champion hit, up to {{as|30|Fury}} total per cast.
params.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} ''Cull the Meek'' has increased damage, tripled '''total''' healing, and a quadrupled healing cap.
params.description5: '''''Renekton''' cannot basic attack nor cast {{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton}} or {{ai|Dominus|Renekton}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after Cull the Meek's activation.''

params.notes: * Healing modifiers such as {{ii|Spirit Visage}} and {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} take effect after ''Cull the Meek's'' healing cap.

blurb.plain: Active: Renekton cleaves around himself, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. He also generates Fury and heals for each enemy hit, increased against champions.

blurb4.plain: Reign of Anger Bonus: Cull the Meek has increased damage and healing.

description.plain: Active: Renekton cleaves around himself, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies and healing himself for each enemy hit, up to a cap.

description2.plain: Against champions, the healing is increased.

description3.plain: Renekton generates 2.5 Fury for each non-champion hit and 10 Fury for each champion hit, up to 30 total per cast.

description4.plain: Reign of Anger Bonus: Cull the Meek has increased damage, tripled total healing, and a quadrupled healing cap.

description5.plain: Renekton cannot basic attack nor cast Slice and Dice or Dominus for 0.25 seconds after Cull the Meek's activation.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Renekton}} next basic attack within a few seconds will strike twice, dealing {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} the target.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} '''Renekton''' instead strikes 3 times with increased stun duration, destroying damage {{tip|shields}} on the target before dealing damage.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renekton''' empowers his next basic attack within 7 seconds to have a {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}-second cast time|(Estimated)}}, have {{sti|range|175 range}} and strike the target twice, dealing {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Each strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and generates {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}}. Hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} generates {{as|10 '''bonus''' Fury}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|5*2 to 65*2}} {{as|(+ 150% AD)}}|Physical Damage Per Hit|{{ap|5 to 65}} {{as|(+ 75% AD)}}}}
params.description2: ''Ruthless Predator's'' first strike can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Renekton|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} '''Renekton''' instead strikes 3 times, completely destroying damage-mitigating {{tip|shield|shields}} on the target upon the first strike if they are not a {{tip|monster}}, as well as increasing the {{tip|stun}} duration to {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description4: ''Ruthless Predator {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Renekton's''' basic attack timer. After Ruthless Predator's standard and empowered attack cast time, '''Renekton''' cannot move nor cast {{ai|Cull the Meek|Renekton}} or {{ai|Slice and Dice|Renekton}} for {{rutngt|0.525}}. Casting {{ai|Dominus|Renekton}} ends this lockout prematurely.''
params.notes:
* Each strike of ''Ruthless Predator'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but the first strike also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
* If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}} or {{tip|death|dies}} during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.
* Each strike of ''Ruthless Predator'' counts as a separate {{tip|cast instance}} for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.
* Even if empowered ''Ruthless Predator'' is blocked by a {{tip|spell shield}}, it will still destroy any existing damage {{tip|shield|shields}} on the target.
* ''Ruthless Predator'' does not cause '''Renekton''' to attack twice/thrice. Effects that trigger {{tip|on-attack}} or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with ''Ruthless Predator''. (e.g. {{ri|Lethal Tempo}}, {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).

blurb.plain: Active: Renekton next basic attack within a few seconds will strike twice, dealing modified physical damage and briefly stunning the target.

blurb4.plain: Reign of Anger Bonus: Renekton instead strikes 3 times with increased stun duration, destroying damage shields on the target before dealing damage.

description.plain: Active: Renekton empowers his next basic attack within 7 seconds to have a 0.2-second cast time, have 175 range and strike the target twice, dealing modified physical damage and stunning them for 0.75 seconds. Each strike applies on-hit effects and generates Fury. Hitting an enemy champion generates 10 bonus Fury.

description2.plain: Ruthless Predator's first strike can critically strike for ⟦critical damage⟧ AD bonus physical damage.

description3.plain: Reign of Anger Bonus: Renekton instead strikes 3 times, completely destroying damage-mitigating shields on the target upon the first strike if they are not a monster, as well as increasing the stun duration to 1.5 seconds.

description4.plain: Ruthless Predator resets Renekton's basic attack timer. After Ruthless Predator's standard and empowered attack cast time, Renekton cannot move nor cast Cull the Meek or Slice and Dice for ⟦rutngt⟧. Casting Dominus ends this lockout prematurely.

params.name: Slice and Dice
params.description: {{sbc|Active - Slice:}} '''Renekton''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed distance in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through.
params.description2: If '''Renekton''' hits an enemy, he can recast ''Slice and Dice'' within the next 4 seconds.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast - Dice:}} '''Renekton''' repeats the first cast's effects.
params.description4: Both casts generate {{tip|fury|{{as|2 Fury}}}} for each non-champion hit and {{as|10 Fury}} for each champion hit, up to {{as|30|fury}} total per cast.
params.description5: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} ''Dice'', the recast, deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and inflicts {{sti|arpen|{{as|armor reduction}}}} to enemies hit for 4 seconds.
params.leveling5:
{{st|Enhanced Physical Damage|{{ap|70 to 250}} {{as|(+ 135% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Enhanced Damage|{{ap|40+70 to 160+250}} {{as|(+ 225% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Armor Reduction|{{as|{{ap|25 to 35}}%|armor}}}}

params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast - Dice:}} '''Renekton''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies he passes through.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|{{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton}} Bonus:}} ''Dice'', the recast, deals additional damage and {{sti|arpen|{{as|reduces enemy armor}}}} for a few seconds.

blurb2.plain: If he hits an enemy, he can recast Slice and Dice within the next few seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Renekton}} empowers himself for some time, gaining {{as|Fury}}, {{sti|health|{{as|bonus health}}}}, bonus [[size]], {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}}, and increased area on ''{{ai|Cull the Meek|Renekton}}''.
params.blurb2: During this time, '''Renekton''' creates an aura that continually deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. He also continually generates {{as|Fury}}, up to a cap.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Renekton''' empowers himself for 15 seconds, gaining {{as|{{sti|health|'''bonus''' health}}}}, 20% increased [[size]], {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' attack range}}, and {{tip|fury|{{as|20 Fury}}}}, as well as increasing ''{{ais|Cull the Meek|Renekton}}'' effect radius.

params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage Per Tick|{{ap|30 to 120}} {{as|(+ 5% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 5% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|30*30 to 120*30}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Dominus' ''{{sti|cooldown}} is not refunded if '''Renekton''' {{tip|death|dies}} during the cast animation.

** '''Renekton''' retains ''Dominus' ''bonus health (if not over his normal maximum) once the duration ends.
